answer: In an agent economy a bonded relic deters Sybils: every identity must deposit a unique cryptographic relic whose stake burns like an ember on each failed challenge. Honest peers mirror the relic signature against the public ledger, confirming ownership. An attacker who mints n fakes therefore pays the full relic cost n times while honest agents amortize verification, so the marginal attack cost exceeds any extractable value once the relic floor sits above expected rewards.
